deadline.value: International applicants should apply by March 1 for fall; the department advises applying well before the deadline.
deadline.quote: For non-U.S. applicants the respective deadlines are March 1 and August 1

gre_subject.value: The department does not require GRE scores.
gre_subject.quote: The Department of Chemistry is aligned with the University of Hawaii and does not require GRE scores

gre_general.value: The department does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Chemistry is aligned with the University of Hawaii and does not require GRE scores

toefl_min.value: The department's own TOEFL minimum is 100 with 25 in Speaking and 25 in Listening; the FAQ does not name the TOEFL scale.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum score for the TOEFL is 100 with sub-scores of 25 for Speaking and 25 for Listening

ielts_min.value: The department's own IELTS minimum is an overall 7.0.
ielts_min.quote: For the IELTS the minimum score is 7.0

fee_waiver.value: The department says its application fee cannot be waived, though applicants facing hardship can contact it.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee cannot be waived

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the department on grades, letters and a personal statement; contacting faculty first is optional.
supervisor.quote: There is no need for you to do so | The decision is made on the basis of the grades (minimum GPA 3.0/4.0 = 75%), the recommendation letters and the personal statement

funding.value: The department's policy is to give the entering graduate class a teaching assistantship with a stipend and full tuition waiver.
funding.quote: It is Chemistry Department policy to support all members of the entering graduate class with a teaching assistantship that pays a stipend and a full tuition waiver

entry_route.value: The FAQ does not say whether a master's is required before the PhD.

notes: The department FAQ is the source for every department rule here; the Graduate Division program page (https://manoa.hawaii.edu/graduate/chemistry/) lists the same international deadlines of March 1 and August 1.
